= UI components

UI component libraries and individual widgets, organized by category.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/component-libraries-and-design-systems/index.adoc[*Component libraries and design systems*] \
  Directories and curated lists of component libraries and design systems.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/multi-platform-design-systems/index.adoc[*Multi-platform design systems*] \
  Design systems and component libraries that target multiple frontend frameworks
  or platforms.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/react-component-libraries/index.adoc[*React component libraries*] \
  Component libraries and design systems built for React.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/standalone-react-components/index.adoc[*Standalone React components*] \
  Individual React components, as opposed to full component libraries.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/vue-component-libraries/index.adoc[*Vue component libraries*] \
  Component libraries and design systems built for Vue.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/standalone-vue-components/index.adoc[*Standalone Vue components*] \
  Individual Vue components, as opposed to full component libraries.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/solidjs-component-libraries/index.adoc[*SolidJS component libraries*] \
  Component libraries built for SolidJS.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/native-web-component-libraries/index.adoc[*Native web component libraries*] \
  Component libraries built on native web components, usable with any framework or
  none at all.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/static-html-progressive-js-component-libraries/index.adoc[*Static HTML + progressive JS component libraries*] \
  Component libraries built with static HTML and progressively enhanced with
  JavaScript, rather than requiring a full framework.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/tailwind-based-component-libraries/index.adoc[*Tailwind-based component libraries*] \
  Component libraries built on top of Tailwind CSS.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/other-web-ui-component-libraries/index.adoc[*Other web UI component libraries*] \
  Web UI component libraries that don't fit into the other, more specific
  categories.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/calendars/index.adoc[*Calendars*] \
  Calendar widgets for displaying and selecting dates.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/file-uploaders/index.adoc[*File uploaders*] \
  Standalone file upload components.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/date-and-time-pickers/index.adoc[*Date and time pickers*] \
  Standalone date and time picker components.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/emoji-pickers/index.adoc[*Emoji pickers*] \
  Standalone emoji picker components.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/tag-inputs/index.adoc[*Tag inputs*] \
  Tag and token input components.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/rich-text-editors-and-code-editors/index.adoc[*Rich-text editors (RTEs) and code editors*] \
  Rich-text editors and code editors for building writing and coding interfaces.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/photo-lightboxes-image-carousels/index.adoc[*Photo lightboxes, image carousels, etc.*] \
  Lightbox and image carousel components for displaying photos.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/tables-and-structured-data-presentation/index.adoc[*Tables and structured data presentation*] \
  Components for presenting tables and other structured data.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/ui-tours/index.adoc[*UI tours*] \
  Components for building guided UI tours and onboarding walkthroughs.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/terminal-emulator-interfaces/index.adoc[*Terminal emulator interfaces*] \
  Terminal emulator components for embedding a command-line interface in the
  browser.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/icon-libraries/index.adoc[*Icon libraries*] \
  Icon libraries and icon components for the web.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/svg-spinners-loading-icons-skeletons/index.adoc[*SVG spinners / loading icons / skeletons*] \
  SVG-based loading spinners, icons, and skeleton screens.

* xref:platforms/the-web-platform/vendors/ui-components/miscellaneous/index.adoc[*Miscellaneous*] \
  UI components that don't fit into the other categories.
